lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Wow, look at that building. It’s so tall!

lines.speaker: TaxiDriver
lines.text: Yeah, that's the Burj Khalifa. First time in Dubai?

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Yes, first time. I just got off the plane... I feel a little lost.

lines.speaker: TaxiDriver
lines.text: Don't worry, my friend. You're safe now. Where are you going?

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: I have an address here... but I think my phone is dead.

lines.speaker: TaxiDriver
lines.text: No problem. Just read it to me. I know this city well.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Thanks. I hope my English is good enough for this.

lines.speaker: TaxiDriver
lines.text: Your English is fine. Let's go.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: أهلاً بيكم في أولى حلقات 'Two Worlds'! وحشتوني؟ أنا كوتش، وصوتكم اللي بيرافقكم في رحلة الإنجليزي. النهاردة إحنا مع ماكال في أول يوم في دبي. واقف في المطار تايه شوية، بس تمام، إحنا معاه.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: إحنا هنتعلم النهاردة إزاي نأخد تاكسي برة مصر، وإزاي نتكلم مع السواق. يعني إيه؟ قلقان؟ ممنوع الخوف! السواق في الرواية بيقول: 'Your English is fine.' يعني إنجليزيتك كويسة. شفتوا؟ ثقة!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: استنّوا ليه؟ اسمعوا كويس الجمل دي: 'I feel a little lost' يعني حاسس إني ضايع شوية. و 'Just read it to me' يعني اقراهاولي بس. دي تلات جمل هتخليك تمشي في الدنيا. يلا نبدأ الرحلة!

lines.speaker: TaxiDriver
lines.text: So, you have the address? Just read it to me, my friend. Take your time.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Okay, let me check my bag. I wrote it on a paper. Here it is. It's in... Al Barsha? Is that right?

lines.speaker: TaxiDriver
lines.text: Yes, Al Barsha! Very good. I know that area well. Do you have a flat there, or are you staying with friends?

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: No, I rented a small flat online. My friend Nour helped me find it. She lives in Dubai, too.

lines.speaker: TaxiDriver
lines.text: That's smart. It's always good to have a friend in a new city. So, first time in the UAE?

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Yes, first time. Everything is so big and bright. I feel a little lost, to be honest. It's a lot to take in.

lines.speaker: TaxiDriver
lines.text: Don't worry, my friend. Everyone feels that way at first. You'll get used to it in a week. Dubai is very easy to live in.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: I hope so. The flight was long, and I didn't sleep much. I just want to put my bags down and rest.

lines.speaker: TaxiDriver
lines.text: Of course. We are on the highway now. It will take about thirty minutes. You can relax. Look out the window — that's the Burj Khalifa on your right.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Wow, it's so tall! I see it from far away, but up here it's... amazing. Can I take a photo?

lines.speaker: TaxiDriver
lines.text: Sure, go ahead! Everyone takes photos on their first day. So, what brings you to Dubai? Work or study?

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Work. I'm looking for a job in marketing. I have some interviews next week. I'm a little nervous about my English, though.

lines.speaker: TaxiDriver
lines.text: Your English is fine, my friend. You're speaking clearly, and I understand you perfectly. Just be confident. That's the most important thing.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Thank you, really. That makes me feel better. How much is the ride to Al Barsha?

lines.speaker: TaxiDriver
lines.text: Don't worry about that now. The meter is running. We'll check it when we arrive. Just sit back and enjoy the view. You're in Dubai now — the city of dreams!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: شفتوا ماكال إزاي؟ كان قلقان شوية، بس اتكلم وعدّى الموقف. عايزين نركز على تلات جمل مهمين سمعناهم في المحادثة دي.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: أول جملة: 'Take your time.' دي بتقال لما حد بيعمل حاجة ببطء، وانت عايز تقوله: متستعجلش، خد وقتك. يعني لما حد يبقى قلقان وبيقولك: 'I'm sorry, I'm slow today'، ترد عليه بكل هدوء: 'No problem, take your time.'

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: الجملة التانية: 'I feel a little lost.' دي بتقال لما تحس إنك تايه أو مش فاهم حاجة. مش لازم تقول: 'I am lost' وتخليها شكلها كبير، لأ، قول: 'a little lost' يعني ضايع شوية، دي بتدي انطباع إنك لسه بتتعود.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: الجملة التالتة: 'What brings you to Dubai?' السواق سألها بدل ما يقول: 'Why are you here?' لأنها أتهذب أكتر. يعني إيه اللي جابك دبي؟ تقدر تستخدمها في أي مكان، مثلاً تقول لحد في القاهرة: 'What brings you to Cairo today?'

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: بس كمان خدوا بالكم من غلطة شائعة جداً. ناس كتير بتقول: 'I came for work.' في الغلط تقول: 'I came for working.' الصح إنك تقول: 'for work' أو 'to work.' متضيفش 'ing' في الحالة دي.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: يلا، ماكال كده اتكسر خوفه وشوية بقى واثق. خلونا نسمع اللي هيحصل لما يوصل الشقة ويلقى مين مستنياه.

lines.speaker: TaxiDriver
lines.text: Okay, sir, here we are — Al Barsha. That will be forty-five dirhams, please.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Here you go. Thanks for the ride — and for the good advice.

lines.speaker: TaxiDriver
lines.text: Anytime, my friend. Good luck with your interviews. You'll do great.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Thanks. Have a good night.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Okay, Macal. You're here. Let's find the building.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Macal! Over here! I came to surprise you!

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Nour! What are you doing here? I thought you were at work!

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: I told them I had a family thing. Come on, let me help you with your bags. How was the flight?

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Long, but the driver was nice. He said I should be confident about my English.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: He's right. You sound great. Now let's get you upstairs. Oh — before I forget — there's someone else who wants to meet you.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Who? Is everything okay?

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Don't worry, it's a good thing. He's a friend of mine — he works at a big marketing company. And he said he's free tonight.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Wait — tonight? Like, an interview? Now?

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Just a quick chat. That's all. But we need to go soon — his coffee meeting is at seven.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Nour, I haven't even unpacked. And I look like I slept on the plane.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: You look fine. But if we hurry, we can stop and get you a proper coffee first. Come on — your new life in Dubai starts now!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: شفتوا؟ ماكال اتحرك وشاف الدنيا قدامه. وشوية شوية بقى عربي وإنجليزي في النص.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: النهاردة ناخد كلمة واحدة بس، بس قويّة. هو فيه أحسن من 'better late than never'؟ يعني إيه؟ إن الأصوب دايماً الأصوب، حتى لو أهو متأخر شوية.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: قبل ما نكمل، لو فيه حد فيكوا حاسس إنه ضعيف في الإنجليزية، أنا عايزكم تقولوا لنفسييتكم: أنا زيه بالظبط. كل مرة كلمة وحدة، كل مرة موقف، وخلاص.
